newsitem.title: USA: Pinnacle Financial increases qtly payout. [CORRECTED 22:07 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle Financial increases qtly payout. [CORRECTED 22:07 GMT]

text.p: Pinnacle Financial Services Inc said Monday it increased its quarterly common stock dividend to $0.235 a share from $0.21 a share previously.
The dividend is payable on April 1 to all shareholders of record on March 21.
The dividend reflects a 12 percent increase over the 21 cents per share rate.

In other board action, Pinnacle said Donald E. Radde, executive vice president and chief lending officer, was appointed to the Pinnacle Bank board of directors while remaining secretary to the board. (Corrects to make clear that Radde becomes a board member, but had already been secretary).

Pinnacle Financial is the parent company of Pinnacle Bank, with 28 offices in Michigan and Indiana along the southern tip of Lake Michigan. As of Dec. 31, 1996, Pinacle had $1.07 billion in total assets.
